title: Nasruddin and the Mirror
summary: Finding a discarded mirror in the dusty road, Nasruddin looked into the glass and gasped: "Heavens! No wonder the owner threw this ugly old face away into the dirt!" And he tossed...
full_text: Finding a discarded mirror in the dusty road, Nasruddin looked into the glass and gasped: "Heavens! No wonder the owner threw this ugly old face away into the dirt!" And he tossed it back into the ditch.
moral: Recognizing one's own image with humility dispels false terror.
